title: Cleansing of Leprosy

questions.question: Who verified that a leper was healed?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:2-3 (ESV): "He shall be brought to the priest, and the priest shall go out of the camp..."

questions.question: What birds were used for the cleansing ceremony?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:4 (ESV): "Take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds..."

questions.question: What happened to the first bird?
options: Killed in an earthenware vessel over fresh water
questions.correctAnswer: Killed in an earthenware vessel over fresh water
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:5 (ESV): "Command... to kill one of the birds in an earthenware vessel over fresh water."

questions.question: What happened to the living bird?
options: Dipped in blood and let go in the open field
questions.correctAnswer: Dipped in blood and let go in the open field
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:6-7 (ESV): "Dip them and the living bird in the blood... and let the living bird go into the open field."

questions.question: What did the cleansed leper have to do to his hair?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:8 (ESV): "He... shall shave off all his hair and wash... and be clean."

questions.question: On what day did he present offerings after entering the camp?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:10 (ESV): "And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs..."

questions.question: Where did the priest put the blood of the guilt offering?
options: Right ear, right thumb, right big toe
questions.correctAnswer: Right ear, right thumb, and right big toe
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:14 (ESV): "Put it on the lobe of the right ear... right thumb... right big toe."

questions.question: What was placed on top of the blood on the ear, thumb, and toe?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:17 (ESV): "Put some of the rest of the oil... on top of the blood of the guilt offering."

questions.question: What wood was used in the ceremony?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:4 (ESV): "Cedar wood and scarlet yarn and hyssop."

questions.question: Could leprosy infect a house?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:34 (ESV): "When... I put a case of leprous disease in a house..."

questions.question: What was done if the disease broke out again in a scraped and replastered house?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:45 (ESV): "He shall break down the house, its stones and timber..."

questions.question: What offerings did a poor leper bring?
options: One male lamb for a guilt offering and two birds
questions.correctAnswer: One male lamb for a guilt offering and two birds
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:21-22 (ESV): "If he is poor... he shall take one male lamb... and two turtledoves."

questions.question: What did the priest do with the leftover oil in his hand?
options: Poured it on the head of him who was to be cleansed
questions.correctAnswer: Poured it on the head of him who was to be cleansed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:18 (ESV): "And the rest of the oil... he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed."

questions.question: For a house to be unclean, what color were the spots?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:37 (ESV): "If the disease is on the walls... with greenish or reddish spots..."

questions.question: What plant was used for sprinkling the house?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 14:51 (ESV): "Take the cedar wood and the hyssop and the scarlet yarn..."

key_verse_text: And the priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed and these things before the Lord, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
